name: ODTN-emulator
description: ODTN project emulator running OpenConfig-compliant NETCONF devices using Netopeer2. Docker-compose creates multiple emulated optical transport nodes.

docker_support.docker_evidence: docker-compose up -d starts two OpenConfig emulators (ports 11002, 11003) and one TAPI emulator (port 11000). Built on libyang, libssh, libnetconf2, sysrepo, Netopeer.

eval_notes: Optical transport-specific NETCONF emulators with OpenConfig models. Multi-device topology via docker-compose. Emulated node has 16 client QSFP28 + 16 line CFP2_ACO ports — realistic for optical transport config evals.
